svg.title: PS memory use in the course report
svg.desc: Approximate memory digitized from the raster plot on page 8. Both error levels use about 92 MB for 1M reference bases, 280 MB for 5M and 900 MB for 20M. The source does not provide original memory logs or specify its peak-memory measurement method.
